LAWH 700.description: Introduction to structure of government, sources of federal, state, and local law, judicial and administrative processes, the role of the lawyer, legal reasoning and analysis, and sources of law that govern and regulate access to U.S. health care system.
LAWH 700.subject: LAWH
LAWH 700.title: Introduction to the Legal System

LAWH 701.description: Holistic understanding of the various aspects of the healthcare system related to sources of care, sources of payment, and regulatory and other legal systems that constrain and control the behavior of these sources and how these sources impact each other.
LAWH 701.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700.
LAWH 701.subject: LAWH
LAWH 701.title: Legal Foundations of Health Care Systems

LAWH 702.description: This course introduces students to the complex world of healthcare compliance. It will prepare students to develop and maintain compliance programs for medical facilities by teaching them the pertinent federal laws and regulations, providing an overview of enforcement and regulatory agencies, and developing ethical protocols.
LAWH 702.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700 and LAWH 701.
LAWH 702.subject: LAWH
LAWH 702.title: Introduction to Healthcare Compliance

LAWH 703.description: This course will utilize reading materials, case studies, and hospital risk management scenarios. Through these materials, students will learn to identify legal, ethical, administrative, compliance, risk management and patient safety issues and reach resolutions for the problems presented. Students will also learn how risk management has changed since the 1998 IOM Report and how the changes impact patients and providers.
LAWH 703.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700 and LAWH 701.
LAWH 703.subject: LAWH
LAWH 703.title: Risk Management, Patient Safety and Quality

LAWH 711.description: This course introduces healthcare professionals enrolled in the Law School's Health law master's or certificate programs to basic leadership principles, and to the hard and soft skills needed to effectively lead healthcare organizations.
LAWH 711.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700 and LAWH 701.
LAWH 711.subject: LAWH
LAWH 711.title: Organizational Leadership and Professional Development for Healthcare Professionals

LAWH 712.description: This course considers and explores the bioethical, medical, and organizational ethical issues encountered in delivering healthcare services. This course also introduces learners to the legal, regulatory and analytical framework guiding and informing healthcare leaders while navigating ethical responsibilities.
LAWH 712.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700, LAWH 701, LAWH 716, LAWH 722, LAWH 736, LAWH 738.
LAWH 712.subject: LAWH
LAWH 712.title: Ethics in Health Care Systems

LAWH 714.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700, LAWH 701, LAWH 716, LAWH 722, LAWH 736, LAWH 738.
LAWH 714.subject: LAWH
LAWH 714.title: Health Care Contracting (Applied Learning)

LAWH 716.description: Medicare reporting and structural requirements for hospitals.
LAWH 716.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700, LAWH 701 (These prerequisites may be waived for a student currently enrolled in the JD program at the University of South Carolina).
LAWH 716.subject: LAWH
LAWH 716.title: Medicare Compliance for Medical Facilities

LAWH 722.description: Identification, prioritization, and management of various risks faced by health care professionals and institutions. (These prerequisites may be waived for a student currently enrolled in the JD program at the University of South Carolina).
LAWH 722.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700 and LAWH 701.
LAWH 722.subject: LAWH
LAWH 722.title: Employment Law

LAWH 736.description: Understanding of the requirements for properly billing third-party payers and survey of federal laws and regulations that prohibit healthcare fraud and self-dealing.
LAWH 736.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700, LAWH 701. (These prerequisites may be waived for a student currently enrolled in the JD program at the University of South Carolina).
LAWH 736.subject: LAWH
LAWH 736.title: Billing Compliance and Healthcare Fraud Prevention I

LAWH 737.description: Advanced issues in bill coding and justification and complexities of fraud and self-dealing prohibitions.
LAWH 737.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700, LAWH 701, LAWH 716, LAWH 722, LAWH 736, LAWH 738 (The prerequisite of LAWH 700 may be waived for a student holding a JD degree or equivalent).
LAWH 737.subject: LAWH
LAWH 737.title: Billing Compliance and Healthcare Fraud Prevention II

LAWH 738.description: Requirements for organizations that handle protected health information, including information about which entities need to comply with laws protecting such information and to what extent. (These prerequisites may be waived for a student currently enrolled in the JD program at the University of South Carolina).
LAWH 738.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700 and LAWH 701.
LAWH 738.subject: LAWH
LAWH 738.title: Healthcare Privacy Security

LAWH 755.description: A supervised research paper or project on a topic related to health systems compliance or other law related issues affecting a health care system. Study culminates in a 30-50 page paper or equivalent research project.
LAWH 755.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in LAWH 700, LAWH 701, LAWH 716, LAWH 722, LAWH 736, LAWH 738.
LAWH 755.subject: LAWH
LAWH 755.title: Directed Independent Study
